Look into the Coverdell Education Savings Account (ESA). This is like a Roth IRA for higher education expenses.   Withdrawals are tax free when used for qualified expenses. Contributions are capped at $2000/year per beneficiary (not per account) so it works well for young kids, and not so well for kids about to go to College. The second thing to consider is that taxes aren't deferred like in a 529 plan.
